name: common-elements
description: The information network for community associations: association records, statutes, vendors, RFPs and the change feed, through the hosted Common Elements MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Look up HOA, condo and co-op association records, read state statutes with citations, vet contractors and licenses, run RFPs, and follow board and management changes. You sign in with your Common Elements account.
defaultPrompt: Use Common Elements to summarize SUNSET CHATEAU CONDO ASSN in Pinellas County, Florida.
Use Common Elements to draft an RFP for our roof replacement, without publishing it.
